ai_summary: Asian Paints Limited reported robust standalone financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with significant year-over-year growth in revenue by 16.7% to ₹9,183.44 Crores and net profit surging by 34.3% to ₹1,478.35 Crores, reflecting strong operational results and improved profitability. The accompanying audit reports for both standalone and consolidated results were unmodified, indicating a clean financial position and no material red flags.
